title: Analytical Theory of Higher-Order Collective Spin Interactions in Cavity Quantum Electrodynamics
summary: Cavity-mediated collective-spin interactions are commonly described by a quadratic one-axis twisting Hamiltonian. However, the underlying atom-light interaction naturally generates nonlinearities to arbitrary order. Here, we derive a closed-form analytical expression for the complete hierarchy of cavity-mediated collective-spin interactions. We show that the nonlinear coefficients $χ_k$ are governed by Chebyshev polynomials, with $k$ the order of nonlinearity.
